meta.title: Guira System LLC — Payment origination and documentation software
meta.description: Guira System LLC is a US-based software and business-services company. We develop and operate a B2B web platform used by Bolivian importers.

identity.tagline: Payment origination and documentation software for international B2B trade.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
paragraphs: Guira System LLC is a US-based software and business-services company. We develop and operate a B2B web platform used by Bolivian small and medium-sized importers to originate and document international supplier payments.

Guira System LLC does not hold, receive, exchange or transmit customer funds. All payment execution and settlement is performed by licensed US financial institutions and licensed payment providers with which we contract; customer funds move only through those licensed providers' accounts and never through Guira System LLC's own accounts.

Our product is the software platform and the compliance documentation package it generates for each transaction: KYC/KYB verification records, supporting commercial documents, a full transaction audit trail and settlement evidence, which our clients use for accounting, customs and audit purposes.

Our revenue consists exclusively of platform license and service fees invoiced to our clients, plus an intercompany service fee from our affiliate GUIRAGLOBAL S.R.L. (La Paz, Bolivia), which provides local advisory services under a fixed monthly retainer.

exclusions.title: What Guira System LLC does not do
items: We do not hold, receive, exchange or transmit customer funds.
We do not operate as a money services business, money transmitter, currency exchange or virtual asset service provider, and we do not perform any activity requiring a money transmission licence.
We do not maintain customer balances or custody of any kind.
We are not a bank and we do not provide banking services.
exclusions.note: Payment execution and settlement are performed exclusively by licensed US financial institutions and licensed payment providers with which we contract.

steps.name: Origination
steps.text: The client company enters a supplier payment instruction on the platform and uploads the underlying commercial documents.

steps.name: Verification
steps.text: Identity and counterparty verification, sanctions and PEP screening are completed through a specialised third-party provider. Every instruction is reviewed by a specialist before it proceeds.

steps.name: Execution
steps.text: Execution and settlement are performed by licensed US financial institutions and licensed payment providers. Funds move through those providers' accounts. They never move through accounts of Guira System LLC.

steps.name: Documentation
steps.text: The platform assembles the complete record of the operation: verification records, supporting commercial documents, audit trail and settlement evidence.

diagram.outsideNote: Outside the Guira System LLC perimeter
diagram.alt: Diagram of the operation. Three stages — origination, verification and documentation — sit inside a dashed perimeter labelled Guira System LLC. The execution and settlement stage sits outside that perimeter, in a separate block labelled licensed US providers, showing that client funds move only through the licensed providers' accounts and never through accounts of Guira System LLC.

deliverables.title: What our clients receive
deliverables.intro: Every operation produces a documentation package built for third-party review:
items: Supporting commercial documents (invoice, purchase order, shipping documents)
A complete transaction audit trail with timestamps
Settlement evidence issued by the executing licensed provider
deliverables.note: Our clients use this package for accounting, customs and audit purposes. This documentation is the product.

advisory.title: Advisory services
paragraphs: Local advisory, onboarding and documentation support in Bolivia are provided by our affiliate GUIRAGLOBAL S.R.L. (La Paz), under a fixed monthly retainer.

The scope of that engagement is advisory and documentary. GUIRAGLOBAL S.R.L. does not receive, hold or move client funds, is not a financial institution and charges no transaction-based or ad valorem fee.

compliance.title: Compliance posture
items: Identity verification (KYC/KYB) and sanctions and PEP screening are performed through a specialised third-party provider before onboarding is completed.
Every payment instruction is reviewed by a specialist before it is submitted for execution.
Records for each operation are retained and made available to the client for accounting and audit purposes.
Execution is contracted exclusively with licensed US financial institutions and licensed payment providers.
